standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chow Homology, the projective space bundle formula, and Same chapter, the description of pushforward of cycles along the correspondence of a graph as pullback of cycles
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the map on Chow groups with the standard formula for the projectivization of a vector bundle.

core_obligations: Reduce by Manin's criterion (proof lines 1394-1401): it suffices to show that the map becomes an isomorphism on Chow groups after tensoring with the motive of an arbitrary smooth projective scheme.

Identify the base change (proof lines 1401-1410): the projectivization of the pulled back vector bundle is the base change of the projectivization, so the statement on Chow groups follows from the projective space bundle formula in intersection theory; pushforward of cycles along the correspondence of the projection is pullback of cycles, hence pushforward along the i-th Chern class correspondence sends a cycle to the i-th power of the first Chern class of the twist capped with the pullback of the cycle.
Conclude (proof lines 1410-1416): with the map on Chow groups thus identified with the standard one, the criterion applies and the map of motives is an isomorphism.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to Chow groups after base change by Manin's criterion.
Identify the map with the classical projective space bundle formula.
Apply the criterion to conclude the isomorphism of motives.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves the projective space bundle formula: the sum of the Chern class correspondences from the direct sum of twisted motives of the base to the motive of the projectivization is an isomorphism (statement lines 1390-1398). The proof (proof lines 1399-1416) reduces by Manin's criterion to the classical formula on Chow groups and identifies the maps using the description of pushforwards along graphs. H2: a complete short reduction.
